description: Find Korean law articles related to a question asked in a sentence (법제처 intelligent law search). The question must be in Korean, e.g. '전세 보증금을 돌려받지 못하면 어떻게 하나요'. scope 행정규칙 searches the articles of administrative rules (notices 고시, directives 훈령). Less relevant articles may be mixed in, so check the text with get_article.

question.description: Your question as a Korean sentence

name: search_law_by_question
title: Find articles by question (문장으로 조문 찾기)
